The Wyoming Department of Transportation has applied for a 201 Exemption Extension to
carry forward the agreement between the City and Profile Properties.Much of the same
reasoning for the original 201Exemption still applies to the situation today.WYDOT
acquired two of the properties under advanced acquisition from Profile Properties and
Fenctrak in 2020. Both properties are required for the new interchange design. WYDOT
took over an existing lease on the property located at 4121 W 5th Street. This lease is set to
expire on April 30, 2023. A final decision on whether or not to extend the lease has not
been made.A short summary of this project status is as follows:
2008: WYDOT completed Feasibility Study
2017: WYDOT Identifies Two Major Infrastructure Projects
2018: WYDOT CompletesI-80Corridor Study
2018: WYDOT Completed Reconnaissance Report
2019: Design and Environmental Project initiated
2020: Preliminary Plans
2020: FONSI Issued
2021: Grading Plans
WYDOT has been applying for grant funding to complete the project design. Once funding
has been secured to finish design work, additional grant funding will need tobe secured for
construction.The status for this project moving forward is dependent on when we receive
grant funding. Our last estimate for construction costs alone ranged between $309,550.000
25:
and $371,460,000, with an additional $23,200,000 being requested in grant funding to
complete the design work. Construction work for this project would be completed in phases.
The first phase includes building the ramp that would impact the properties in question under
this 201 Exemption Extension.Please see the attached exhibits which shows our plan for
what will become Highway right of way and the proposed design for the ramp in this location.
One of the State of Wyoming's and WYDOT's goals is to be good stewards of federal and state
funds.It would be in the best interest of both WYDOT and the State of Wyoming to continue to
use the existing buildings for their current interim use, as best property management practice.
The improvements and any infrastructure will be removed once funding has been secured for the
next phase of the project.WYDOT is under the opinion that it would be a misuse of federal and
state funds to install new infrastructure to buildings that will be demolished as part of the new
interchange ramp.
Thank you for your time and attention to this matter. If you have further questions please
contact Jonathan Clark at 307-777-4249 or at Jonathan.clark@wyo.gov.
